reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in your DM to confirm the new time: their Marrow Fieldworks call for the Tamarack rollout is Thursdays at 9:30 from now on.

I can't save memories between conversations, so I told them the note will stay in the DM where either of us can look it up. I also offered to add it to their calendar as a recurring event. As they asked, I didn't do anything else and didn't share the note anywhere.
